g.text: Six identical machines, two completely different things
Stateless peers. No coordination, no shared decisions.
Kill one and nothing has to be agreed.
Members know each other, elect a leader, and must AGREE.
Kill the leader and the rest hold an election.
Quorum = ⌊N/2⌋ + 1. With 3 nodes you need 2 to agree.
A minority that loses contact must stop, or you get split-brain.
A cluster provides a single consistent answer despite failures.
They solve different problems and often sit in the same system.
